hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels validates each reservation entry against the same un-decremented available_quantity, so a single cart with two line items sharing the WIDGET inventory item (OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3, needing 12 units against 10 stock) should pass the batch check at complete-cart time and persist a reservation of 12 units, oversubscribing the location. I expect no_oversell to fail because live reservations (12) exceed stocked quantity (10), and reserved_matches_reservations should still pass since the counter is summed consistently.
